claims.statement: The revised Construction Products Regulation requires an electronic declaration of performance and conformity unless it is provided through a compliant digital product passport.
The construction passport is designed to include declarations, technical documentation, labels and unique identifiers with role-based access.
Demand hypothesis: laboratories can distribute a neutral ledger because their test outputs are the earliest authoritative evidence in the release chain.

contrary_evidence: Manufacturers can publish declarations on their own maintained websites.
Construction-passport adoption is phased and depends on later product-specific acts and standards.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: laboratories bundle the ledger after testing rather than the founder selling factory by factory
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 200 manufacturers averaging 35000 PLN recurring annual revenue plus onboarding could exceed 7m PLN ARR and support founder equity over 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 14-20 hours weekly with external construction-product expertise
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 72-86% once characteristic and translation templates are reusable
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 9-15 months with eight family onboardings and twenty subscriptions
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 12000-40000 PLN onboarding per family plus 1200-3500 PLN monthly maintenance
economics.retention_or_repeat: New variants, changed inputs, renewed tests, translations and future passport migrations

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A versioned mapping from test evidence to characteristics, variants and country outputs compounds with every approved family
fingerprint.customer: Small and mid-sized EU manufacturers of repeatable construction-product families
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded in construction-product laboratories, technical assessment bodies and specialist distributors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Evidence ledger and declaration generator sold as subscription plus per-family managed onboarding
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Manufacturer pays per product-family onboarding, declaration issuance and maintained market-language set
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A product family or variant is released and must carry consistent performance, conformity and technical evidence across markets

founder_fit: Data lineage and rule mapping fit the founder's technical profile
Renewable installers can expose candidate construction-product suppliers
A single product-family pilot is compatible with part-time work
risks: Building too early for product groups not yet activated
Incorrect characteristic mapping could create market-access liability
Laboratory information systems may expand into this layer

structure.control_point: The immutable declaration package released before a SKU is supplied
structure.critical_dependency: Product-specific harmonised specifications and the phased construction passport rollout

thesis: A testing-lab-embedded ledger could bind test results, harmonised specifications, translations and product identifiers into machine-readable declarations of performance and conformity, then migrate those records into the construction digital-product-passport system as product groups activate. It would not replace assessment bodies. Demand and economics are hypotheses.
title: Construction-Product Declaration Ledger
uncertainties: Manufacturer willingness to pay beyond document consulting
